quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What colors are the signs that show the distance to the next highway exit?

options.text: Yellow with black letters
Black with white letters
Red with white letters
Green with white letters

questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Green signs with white letters show destination information.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you use?

options.text: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
Turn into the lane marked with an arrow.
Turn into the middle lane.
Turn into any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks can your body process in one hour?

options.text: Three alcoholic drinks
One alcoholic drink
Two alcoholic drinks
None of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: One alcoholic drink
questions.explanation: Your body processes about one alcoholic drink per hour. How impaired you become depends on how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your body weight, what you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: What should you do if an oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane?

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk your horn to get attention. If the other driver does not move, steer right. Do not steer left because the other driver may correct at the last moment and you will still crash. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact.

questions.question: What color are the road markings that separate traffic lanes going in opposite directions?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge into traffic. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and tells you the safe speed to drive (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What is the first thing you should do to slow down on a slippery road?

options.text: Firmly apply your brakes.
Take your foot off the gas pedal.
Use your parking brake.
Pump your brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: First, take your foot off the gas. If you need to slow down more, gently apply steady pressure to your brake pedal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right.
Double curve.
Winding road.
Pavement ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. Yield to all vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What are regulatory signs?

options.text: Signs placed where there is immediate danger.
Signs that tell you what you must or must not do.
Diamond-shaped signs that are yellow or green.
Signs that warn about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signs that tell you what you must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white background. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, no passing zones, turn restrictions, and other driving rules.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left curve is ahead.
A series of curves is ahead.
An S-curve is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: When two cars reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The larger vehicle.
The car on the left.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must let the driver on the right go first. The driver on the left can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When is it okay to use your horn?

options.text: When you have to stop quickly.
When you are passing another car.
When you have lost control of your car.
When you are passing a bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you have lost control of your car.
questions.explanation: You should use your horn if you lose control of your vehicle. This alerts other drivers to the danger.

questions.question: How should you treat railroad crossings?

options.text: They are safe because trains rarely come.
They are dangerous.
They are safe places to park.
You must always stop there.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are dangerous.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs and signals. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Narrow bridge ahead.
A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
Industrial area.
Freeway on-ramp ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
U-turns are not allowed.
You may go if the way is clear.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way. You could have a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: Can you pass on a two-lane road if there is a single solid yellow line on your side of the center?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means no passing. You can only pass when the yellow line on your side is broken (dashed).

questions.question: When can you NOT cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front of you is broken down.
When passing on the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if it is safe and does not interfere with other traffic.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on interstate highways in rural areas?

options.text: 50 mph
60 mph
70 mph
80 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 70 mph
questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit on interstate highways is 70 mph.

questions.question: How should you park uphill on a street with a curb?

options.text: Keep the front wheel straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn your wheels away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll toward the curb, not into traffic.

questions.question: What does a red flashing traffic light mean?

options.text: A solid red light.
A stop sign.
A yield sign.
A caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: If an oncoming vehicle uses high beams, where should you look?

options.text: Either side
The center
The right side
The left side

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on your course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed you can drive on a road under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed you can drive on a road under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed to drive on a road under ideal conditions.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed you can drive on a road under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the maximum or minimum legal speed for a road under ideal conditions. You can drive slower than the posted speed, but you cannot drive faster. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, or bad weather.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always bring the car to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be ready to stop. Look both ways to make sure no trains are coming. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance from the tracks and wait until it passes.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: It can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
It has a triangular shape.
It is blue with black lettering.
It shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: It shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Speed restriction signs show a recommended speed for curves and turns. You should follow this speed in fair weather. Always drive slower on wet, snowy, or icy roads.

questions.question: If a traffic light shows both red and a green arrow, can you turn in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You do not have to wait for the red light to change. First, yield to any traffic already in the intersection or crosswalk.

questions.question: You want to turn left at a green light, but traffic is heavy. What should you do?

options.text: Use the next intersection.
Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Go because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with a green light, you can enter the intersection to prepare. Wait in the center for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: When must you yield to other drivers?

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on your left at an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield when entering a street from a garage, driveway, or alley. You must also yield to pedestrians on an intersecting sidewalk.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill is ahead.
You must turn left.
Do not enter.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A four-way intersection is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does a solid white line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and you can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
Children are playing ahead.
A pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: When you see a steady yellow arrow on a traffic signal, you should:

options.text: Merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop, if it is safe to do so.
Turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Go ahead because you have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop, if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road widens ahead.
The right lane ends soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street with no emergency signals on. What should you do?

options.text: Drive normally.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive normally.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without using its siren or lights, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: The most important thing about speed on curves is:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit when entering the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle may slide on curves due to its momentum. Slow down before entering the curve to stay in control.
